# An external newline-containing project path resolves through real Git without breaking argv.
exec zwm --project $ZWM_TEST_NEWLINE_PROJECT co feature/newline
cmpenv stdout created
! stderr .
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- created --
worktree_path=$ZWM_TEST_NEWLINE_PATH
display_identity=feature/newline
tab_action=created
tab_title=$ZWM_TEST_NEWLINE_KEY:feature/newline
tab_worktree=$ZWM_TEST_NEWLINE_PATH
-- want-log --

{"sequence":4,"command":"git","args":["show-ref","--verify","--quiet","refs/heads/feature/newline"],"cwd":"$WORK/external/newline\nproject"}
{"sequence":5,"command":"git","args":["worktree","list","--porcelain","-z"],"cwd":"$WORK/external/newline\nproject"}
